--!strict
-- Records the UI events that reach UiWidgets.scene's Menu canvas (Docs/Decisions/0033-m22-contract.md decisions 27 and
-- 36): every UI event bubbles from its element through its ancestors to the canvas, where this behaviour receives it, so
-- the UiWidgets suite reads what its injected input raised, and Assets/Tests/Replays/Ui.replay's expectations what its
-- input changed. It returns nothing, so no event stops here (nothing is above the canvas anyway). The log keeps only the
-- latest Capacity entries, in a ring, and each tally one entry per element name, so a long session (the hardening soak
-- plays the scene for 10,000 ticks) does not grow the script heap; reading entries the ring has dropped is an error.
export type UiRecorder = ScriptInstance & {
	Count: number,
	Ring: { string },
	Clicks: { [string]: number },
	Cancels: { [string]: number },
	Values: { [string]: boolean | number },
	Scrolls: { [string]: vector },
	Since: (self: UiRecorder, cursor: number) -> string,
}

local UiRecorder = {}

UiRecorder.Capacity = 64

local function Record(self: UiRecorder, entry: string)
	self.Count += 1
	self.Ring[(self.Count - 1) % UiRecorder.Capacity + 1] = entry
end

function UiRecorder.OnCreate(self: UiRecorder)
	self.Count = 0
	self.Ring = {}
	self.Clicks = {}
	self.Cancels = {}
	self.Values = {}
	self.Scrolls = {}
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiClick(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity): boolean?
	self.Clicks[element.Name] = (self.Clicks[element.Name] or 0) + 1
	Record(self, `Click:{element.Name}`)
	return nil
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiValueChanged(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity, value: boolean | number): boolean?
	self.Values[element.Name] = value
	Record(self, `Value:{element.Name}:{tostring(value)}`)
	return nil
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiFocus(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity, focused: boolean): boolean?
	Record(self, `Focus:{element.Name}:{tostring(focused)}`)
	return nil
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiHover(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity, hovered: boolean): boolean?
	Record(self, `Hover:{element.Name}:{tostring(hovered)}`)
	return nil
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiCancel(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity): boolean?
	self.Cancels[element.Name] = (self.Cancels[element.Name] or 0) + 1
	Record(self, `Cancel:{element.Name}`)
	return nil
end

function UiRecorder.OnUiScroll(self: UiRecorder, element: Entity, position: vector): boolean?
	self.Scrolls[element.Name] = position
	Record(self, `Scroll:{element.Name}:{position.x},{position.y}`)
	return nil
end

-- The entries recorded after `cursor` (a Count read earlier), joined with commas.
function UiRecorder.Since(self: UiRecorder, cursor: number): string
	if cursor < self.Count - UiRecorder.Capacity then
		error(`UiRecorder: the entries after cursor {cursor} were dropped; only the latest {UiRecorder.Capacity} are kept`)
	end
	local entries: { string } = {}
	for index = cursor + 1, self.Count do
		table.insert(entries, self.Ring[(index - 1) % UiRecorder.Capacity + 1])
	end
	return table.concat(entries, ",")
end

return Script.Define("UiRecorder", UiRecorder)

--!strict
-- The widget proxies and UiWidgets.scene (Architecture §15.6 gates 1, 1b and 4; Docs/Decisions/0033-m22-contract.md
-- decision 36): Scaffold/UiWidgets.jsonl wrote the four widgets with every field non-default somewhere (a disabled button,
-- toggle, slider and scroll view, widgets that are not Focusable and a Focusable scroll view, a Vertical slider, a
-- horizontal scroll view at a scroll position), the canvas's Font, Theme and DefaultFocus, and both RaycastTarget values,
-- so the scene renders through Test.Screenshot in every mode, and every field of UiButton, UiToggle, UiSlider and
-- UiScrollView, and the fields W22.2 added to UiCanvas, UiImage and UiText, read back what the scaffold authored and are
-- written through their proxies, every UiLayoutDirection value included.
local Support = require("./Support")

local INTER = "Assets/Ui/Fonts/Inter-Regular.otf"
local GLYPHS = "Assets/Formats/Fonts/Glyphs.ttf"
local EPSILON = 1e-6
local DIRECTIONS: { UiLayoutDirection } = { "Horizontal", "Vertical" }

local function load(path: string): AssetRef
	local asset = Assets.Load(path)
	assert(asset, `{path} loads`)
	return asset
end

return Test.Suite("Api.UiWidgets", function()
	Test.Case("the widgets scene renders", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "UiWidgets")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.Screenshot("UiWidgets")
	end)

	Test.Case("UiButton fields read and write through the proxy", function()
		local play = Support.Find("Play").UiButton :: UiButton
		Test.ExpectEqual(play.Interactable, true, "Play is interactable")
		Test.ExpectEqual(play.Focusable, true, "Play is focusable")
		local quit = Support.Find("Quit").UiButton :: UiButton
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(quit, "Interactable", true), false, "the scene's Quit is disabled")
		local hud = Support.Find("Hud").UiButton :: UiButton
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(hud, "Focusable", true), false, "the scene's Hud is not focusable")
	end)

	Test.Case("UiToggle fields read and write through the proxy", function()
		local music = Support.Find("Music").UiToggle :: UiToggle
		local check = Support.Find("MusicCheck")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(music, "IsOn", false), true, "the scene's Music is on")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(music, "Graphic", nil), check, "the scene's Music shows MusicCheck")
		Support.RoundTrip(music, "Graphic", check)
		local hints = Support.Find("Hints").UiToggle :: UiToggle
		Test.ExpectEqual(hints.IsOn, false, "the scene's Hints is off")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(hints, "Focusable", true), false, "the scene's Hints is not focusable")
		local locked = Support.Find("Locked").UiToggle :: UiToggle
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(locked, "Interactable", true), false, "the scene's Locked is disabled")
	end)

	Test.Case("UiSlider fields read and write through the proxy", function()
		local volume = Support.Find("Volume").UiSlider :: UiSlider
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Value", 40), 25, "the scene's value")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Min", 10), 0, "the scene's Min")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Max", 90), 100, "the scene's Max")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "WholeNumbers", false), true, "the scene's WholeNumbers")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Step", 2.5), 5, "the scene's step")
		Test.ExpectEqual(volume.Direction, "Horizontal", "the scene's Volume is horizontal")
		for _, direction in DIRECTIONS do
			Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Direction", direction)
		end
		local fill = Support.Find("VolumeFill")
		local handle = Support.Find("VolumeHandle")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Fill", nil), fill, "the scene's fill")
		Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Fill", fill)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Handle", nil), handle, "the scene's handle")
		Support.RoundTrip(volume, "Handle", handle)
		local brightness = Support.Find("Brightness").UiSlider :: UiSlider
		Test.ExpectEqual(brightness.Direction, "Vertical", "the scene's Brightness is vertical")
		Test.ExpectEqual(brightness.Min, -1, "Brightness's Min")
		Test.ExpectEqual(brightness.Value, 0.5, "Brightness's value")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(brightness, "Focusable", true), false, "the scene's Brightness is not focusable")
		local dimmer = Support.Find("Dimmer").UiSlider :: UiSlider
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(dimmer, "Interactable", true), false, "the scene's Dimmer is disabled")
	end)

	Test.Case("UiScrollView fields read and write through the proxy", function()
		local list = Support.Find("List").UiScrollView :: UiScrollView
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.Vertical, true, "the scene's List scrolls vertically")
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.Horizontal, false, "and not horizontally")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(list, "Focusable", false), true, "the scene's List is focusable")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(list, "ScrollStep", 12), 30, "the scene's scroll step")
		local items = Support.Find("Items")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(list, "Content", nil), items, "the scene's content")
		Support.RoundTrip(list, "Content", items)
		local strip = Support.Find("Strip").UiScrollView :: UiScrollView
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(strip, "Interactable", true), false, "the scene's Strip is disabled")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(strip, "Horizontal", false), true, "the scene's Strip scrolls horizontally")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(strip, "Vertical", true), false, "and not vertically")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(strip, "ScrollPosition", vector.create(80, 0, 0), EPSILON), vector.create(40, 0, 0), EPSILON)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(strip, "Content", nil), Support.Find("Row"), "the Strip's content")
	end)

	Test.Case("the canvas's Font, Theme and DefaultFocus read and write through the proxy", function()
		local canvas = Support.Find("Menu").UiCanvas :: UiCanvas
		local inter = load(INTER)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(canvas, "Font", nil), inter, "the scene's canvas font")
		Support.RoundTrip(canvas, "Font", load(GLYPHS))
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(canvas, "DefaultFocus", Support.Find("Music")), Support.Find("Play"), "the scene's default focus")
		Support.RoundTrip(canvas, "DefaultFocus", nil)
		local theme = canvas.Theme
		Support.ExpectColorNear(theme.Normal, Color.New(0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 1), EPSILON, "the scene's Normal tint")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(theme.Hovered, Color.New(0.8, 0.9, 1, 1), EPSILON, "the scene's Hovered tint")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(theme.Pressed, Color.New(0.55, 0.65, 0.75, 1), EPSILON, "the scene's Pressed tint")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(theme.Focused, Color.New(1, 0.9, 0.6, 1), EPSILON, "the scene's Focused tint")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(theme.Disabled, Color.New(0.45, 0.45, 0.45, 0.6), EPSILON, "the scene's Disabled tint")
		canvas.Theme = {
			Normal = Color.New(1, 1, 1, 1),
			Hovered = Color.New(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1),
			Pressed = Color.New(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 1),
			Focused = Color.New(0, 0.5, 1, 1),
			Disabled = Color.New(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2),
		}
		local written = canvas.Theme
		Support.ExpectColorNear(written.Normal, Color.New(1, 1, 1, 1), EPSILON, "Theme reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(written.Hovered, Color.New(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1), EPSILON, "Theme reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(written.Pressed, Color.New(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 1), EPSILON, "Theme reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(written.Focused, Color.New(0, 0.5, 1, 1), EPSILON, "Theme reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(written.Disabled, Color.New(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2), EPSILON, "Theme reads back what was written")
	end)

	Test.Case("RaycastTarget reads and writes through the UiImage and UiText proxies", function()
		local backdrop = Support.Find("Backdrop").UiImage :: UiImage
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(backdrop, "RaycastTarget", true), false, "the backdrop lets the pointer through")
		local title = Support.Find("Title").UiText :: UiText
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(title, "RaycastTarget", true), false, "the title lets the pointer through")
		local label = Support.Find("PlayLabel").UiText :: UiText
		Test.ExpectEqual(label.RaycastTarget, true, "a button's label catches the pointer for its button")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- UI interaction in every mode (Architecture §15.6 gates 2 and 3; Docs/Decisions/0033-m22-contract.md decisions 22 to 28
-- and 36): injected keys, gamepad buttons and pointer presses drive UiWidgets.scene's widgets through the UiInput phase,
-- every Ui function is called, and every OnUi callback reaches the UiRecorder on the Menu canvas, bubbling from its
-- element. Keyboard and gamepad navigation starts at the canvas's DefaultFocus (Play), and the project's Ui settings add
-- Backspace to Cancel and the right bumper to Next (Scaffold/UiWidgets.jsonl), which a case observes. The suite runs with
-- Isolation "Case", so every case starts from a fresh session with nothing focused. Assets/Tests/Replays/Ui.replay drives
-- the same scene with what Test.Inject* cannot give: the pointer's moves, a slider drag and the wheel.
local RecorderScript = require("../../Scripts/UiWidgets/UiRecorder")

local function Find(name: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByName(name)
	assert(entity ~= nil, name .. " is in UiWidgets.scene")
	return entity
end

local function Recorder(): RecorderScript.UiRecorder
	return Find("Menu"):GetScript() :: RecorderScript.UiRecorder
end

-- The laid-out rectangle of `name`, in scene pixels (the view's pixels in a lockstep session).
local function Rect(name: string): UiElementRect
	local rect = Ui.GetRect(Find(name))
	assert(rect ~= nil, name .. " is laid out")
	return rect
end

local function Centre(name: string): vector
	local rect = Rect(name)
	return (rect.Min + rect.Max) / 2
end

-- A tap applies at the next tick and releases at the one after; each helper resumes once both have run.
local function TapKey(key: Key)
	Test.InjectKey(key, "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

local function TapPad(button: GamepadButton)
	Test.InjectGamepad(0, button, "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

local function ClickAt(position: vector)
	Test.InjectMouse("Left", "Tap", position)
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

return Test.Suite("UiWidgets", function()
	Test.Case("keyboard and gamepad navigation start at the canvas's DefaultFocus, and Submit clicks the focused button", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local cursor = recorder.Count
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), nil, "nothing has focus at the start")
		TapKey("Enter")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Count, cursor, "Submit does nothing while nothing has focus")
		TapKey("Up")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Play"), "the first command focuses the canvas's DefaultFocus, whatever its direction")
		TapKey("Enter")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Clicks.Play, 1, "Submit clicks the focused button")
		TapKey("Right")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Music"), "Right moves to the nearest focusable widget to the right")
		TapPad("DPadLeft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Play"), "the gamepad's DPadLeft moves back")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder:Since(cursor), "Focus:Play:true,Click:Play,Focus:Play:false,Focus:Music:true,Focus:Music:false,Focus:Play:true")
	end)

	Test.Case("the pointer hovers, presses and clicks, and a press focuses only a focusable widget", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local cursor = recorder.Count
		Test.InjectMouse("Left", "Down", Centre("Play"))
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetHovered(), Find("Play"), "the pointer is over Play")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetPressed(), Find("Play"), "the press began on Play")
		Test.Expect(Ui.IsPointerOverUi(), "Play catches the pointer")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Play"), "a press focuses a focusable widget")
		Test.InjectMouse("Left", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetPressed(), nil, "the release ends the press")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Clicks.Play, 1, "a press and release over Play click it")
		ClickAt(Centre("Hud"))
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Clicks.Hud, 1, "a button that is not Focusable is clicked")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Play"), "without taking focus")
		ClickAt(Centre("Quit"))
		Test.Expect(Ui.IsPointerOverUi(), "a disabled button catches the pointer")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetHovered(), nil, "but is never hovered")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Clicks.Quit, nil, "nor clicked")
		ClickAt(Centre("Title"))
		Test.Expect(not Ui.IsPointerOverUi(), "the title and the backdrop let the pointer through")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder:Since(cursor), "Hover:Play:true,Focus:Play:true,Click:Play,Hover:Play:false,Hover:Hud:true,Click:Hud,Hover:Hud:false")
	end)

	Test.Case("Submit flips a focused toggle, and the directions along a focused slider step it", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local cursor = recorder.Count
		local music = Find("Music").UiToggle :: UiToggle
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Music"))
		TapKey("Space")
		Test.ExpectEqual(music.IsOn, false, "Space submits the focused toggle")
		TapPad("South")
		Test.ExpectEqual(music.IsOn, true, "and so does the gamepad's South")
		local volume = Find("Volume").UiSlider :: UiSlider
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Volume"))
		TapKey("Right")
		Test.ExpectEqual(volume.Value, 30, "Right steps a horizontal slider by its Step")
		TapPad("DPadLeft")
		TapPad("DPadLeft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(volume.Value, 20, "DPadLeft steps it back")
		TapKey("Down")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Item1"), "a direction across the slider navigates")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Values.Music, true, "the toggle's last value")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Values.Volume, 20, "the slider's last value")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder:Since(cursor),
			"Focus:Music:true,Value:Music:false,Value:Music:true,Focus:Music:false,Focus:Volume:true,Value:Volume:30,Value:Volume:25,"
				.. "Value:Volume:20,Focus:Volume:false,Focus:Item1:true")
	end)

	Test.Case("a pointer press sets a slider from the pointer, and one that is not Focusable leaves focus as it is", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local brightness = Find("Brightness").UiSlider :: UiSlider
		local rect = Rect("Brightness")
		-- Seven eighths of the way up from the bottom edge, its Min: -1 + 2 * 0.875.
		ClickAt(vector.create((rect.Min.x + rect.Max.x) / 2, rect.Max.y - (rect.Max.y - rect.Min.y) * 0.875, 0))
		Test.ExpectNear(brightness.Value, 0.75, 1e-5)
		Test.ExpectNear(recorder.Values.Brightness :: number, 0.75, 1e-5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), nil, "Brightness is not Focusable")
	end)

	Test.Case("focus inside a scroll view's content scrolls it into view, and a focused scroll view steps along its axis", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local cursor = recorder.Count
		local list = Find("List").UiScrollView :: UiScrollView
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.ScrollPosition, vector.zero, "the list starts at its top")
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Item6"))
		-- Item6 spans 250 to 300 units below the content's top, and the view is 200 units high.
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.ScrollPosition, vector.create(0, 100, 0), "focusing Item6 scrolls it to the view's bottom edge at once")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("List"))
		TapKey("Down")
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.ScrollPosition, vector.create(0, 130, 0), "Down steps the focused list by its ScrollStep")
		TapPad("DPadUp")
		Test.ExpectEqual(list.ScrollPosition, vector.create(0, 100, 0), "and DPadUp steps it back")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Scrolls.List, vector.create(0, 100, 0), "the list's last scroll position")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder:Since(cursor), "Focus:Item6:true,Scroll:List:0,100,Focus:Item6:false,Focus:List:true,Scroll:List:0,130,Scroll:List:0,100")
	end)

	Test.Case("Cancel reaches the focused element, else the last canvas", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		TapKey("Escape")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Cancels.Menu, 1, "with nothing focused, Cancel reaches the canvas")
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Play"))
		TapPad("East")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Cancels.Play, 1, "the gamepad's East cancels at the focused button")
	end)

	Test.Case("the project's Ui bindings add Backspace to Cancel and the right bumper to Next, and Shift turns Next into Previous", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Play"))
		TapPad("RightBumper")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Music"), "Next is the following focusable widget in draw order")
		TapKey("Backspace")
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder.Cancels.Music, 1, "Backspace cancels")
		TapKey("Tab")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Volume"), "Tab is Next")
		Test.InjectKey("LeftShift", "Down")
		TapKey("Tab")
		Test.InjectKey("LeftShift", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Music"), "Shift and Tab is Previous")
	end)

	Test.Case("Ui.SetFocus refuses an element that cannot take focus, nil clears focus, and GetRect reads the layout", function()
		local recorder = Recorder()
		local cursor = recorder.Count
		for _, name in { "Quit", "Hud", "Hints", "Locked", "Dimmer", "Brightness", "Strip", "Title" } do
			Test.Expect(not pcall(Ui.SetFocus, Find(name)), `{name} cannot take focus`)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), nil, "a refused element changes nothing")
		Ui.SetFocus(Find("Item1"))
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), Find("Item1"), "focus changes at once")
		Ui.SetFocus(nil)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetFocus(), nil, "nil clears focus")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(recorder:Since(cursor), "Focus:Item1:true,Focus:Item1:false")
		local play = Rect("Play")
		Test.ExpectEqual(play.Min, vector.create(40, 100, 0), "Play's top-left corner in scene pixels")
		Test.ExpectEqual(play.Max, vector.create(280, 156, 0), "Play's bottom-right corner in scene pixels")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Ui.GetRect(Find("Camera")), nil, "an entity that is no UI element has no rectangle")
	end)
end)
